questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 53x^2 + 102 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 51)(x^2 - 2) = 0$ with $51 \neq 2 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{51}, \pm\sqrt{2}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Sequence & Series (Harmonic Means & Special Summations).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 53x + 52 = 0$ and $x^2 - 4x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (4) + k = 0 \implies k = 3$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Sequence & Series (Arithmetico-Geometric Progression (AGP)).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 106x + 8 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{106} = \frac{q}{8} \implies p = 53,\; q = 4 \implies p + q = 57$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Sequence & Series (Method of Telescoping Differences).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 5$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 10x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 5$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(5) < 0 \implies 5^2 - 2(5^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 25$, so largest integer is $24$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Sequence & Series (AM-GM-HM Inequalities).

questions.question: At what abscissa $x$ is the normal to the curve $y = x^2 - 4x$ parallel to the $y$-axis?
